clue.text: Turns up in headgear held together by glue

indicators.note: the headgear is bound round the glue, so the glue word sits within the headgear word

parts.note: caps are a kind of headgear
size is a gluey sizing material used by decorators and bookbinders

explanation.surface: A milliner's hats are found stuck together with adhesive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turns up' is the definition in the sense of a boat overturning, not of arriving.
explanation.definitionFit: A boat that overturns, keel to the sky, is said to do this; both verbs are third person singular.

clue.text: A commissioned officer briefly trampled on by horse becomes blue

indicators.note: in a down clue, the horse stands on top of what follows it

parts.note: a cob is a sturdy short-legged horse
LT is the short form of lieutenant

explanation.surface: A lieutenant is kicked by a horse and goes black and blue.
explanation.definitionFit: The deep blue pigment is named for the metal that colours it.

clue.text: Greek character, spirited, stealing ideas?

parts.note: pi is a letter of the Greek alphabet
racy means lively or spirited

explanation.surface: A lively Greek is accused of plagiarism.
explanation.definitionFit: Copying protected work is called this, by extension from robbery at sea; the question mark admits the stretch.

clue.text: One doesn't react, being troubled by 7

indicators.note: troubled letters are disturbed into a new order

parts.note: the answer to 7 Down, people showing no gratitude

explanation.surface: Someone stays unmoved despite being bothered by ungrateful folk.
explanation.definitionFit: Neon or argon are chemically inactive elements that do not combine with other substances.

clue.text: Birds with little energy having problem getting up

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for energy

indicators.note: in a down clue, getting up means reading upwards, so backwards

parts.note: a sum is an arithmetic problem

explanation.surface: Listless birds have trouble rising.
explanation.definitionFit: These large flightless Australian runners are a kind of bird.

clue.text: Failing to act or lying

definitions.meaning: passive and inert, showing no will to do anything
stretched out flat on one's back

explanation.surface: Someone is accused of either doing nothing or telling untruths.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lying' tempts as untruthfulness; here it is lying face upward.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both morally passive and physically reclining face up, two adjective senses.

clue.text: HE institution, which in Paris, is unlike any other

parts.note: HE is higher education, and a uni is a university
que is French for which

explanation.surface: A university that is one of a kind, perhaps a French one.
explanation.definitionFit: Something one of a kind, with no equal, is matchless.

clue.text: Those showing no appreciation could make one angriest

indicators.note: the following word's letters could be made into something else

explanation.surface: Ungrateful people would make anyone livid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one' is a link here, the surface's 'anyone'.
explanation.definitionFit: People who show no thanks for kindness are the ungrateful.

clue.text: Leaders of English society with wise words can be trying

indicators.note: leaders are the front letters of the two words

parts.note: a saying is a proverb, words of wisdom

explanation.surface: Members of the English upper classes with their maxims are tiresome.
explanation.definitionFit: To essay something is an old word for attempting it, so both are present participles of attempt.

clue.text: Handsome chaps crossing ring road to get wine

indicators.note: the handsome chaps span across the other pieces, which therefore go inside

parts.note: beaux are dandies or fine-looking admirers
a ring is round, the shape of the letter O

explanation.surface: Good-looking men walk over a ring road to buy a bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: Claret is the red produced around the French city of the same name, a classic wine region.

clue.text: Colours used in painting especially

indicators.note: the letters are put to use within the two words that follow, read straight through

explanation.surface: An artist says which pigments featured particularly in a canvas.
explanation.definitionFit: To tint something lightly is to colour it; both are verbs in the third person.

clue.text: Orchestration achieving a success

definitions.meaning: hitting a target or getting a goal or a point

explanation.surface: An arranger's work is a triumph.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means writing out music for performers and also notching up goals or points.

clue.text: Firm suffering setback in dead place

indicators.note: the reversed firm goes within the word for dead

parts.note: the late so-and-so is someone who has died

indicators.note: a setback sends the firm word backwards

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm

explanation.surface: A business in decline finds itself in a lifeless spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'place' looks like a noun but is the verb: to find or pinpoint.
explanation.definitionFit: To pinpoint or situate something is to find its position, a verb synonym.

clue.text: A Conservative minister's office? Watch out if you don't get this!

definitions.text: Watch out if you don't get this!

parts.note: a curacy is the post held by a curate, a junior church minister

explanation.surface: A Tory clergyman's post prompts a warning to anyone who misses the mark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'minister' suggests government, but this is a church minister.
explanation.definitionFit: Precision is what a careless marksman lacks, so the exclamation is a cryptic hint at correctness.

clue.text: British land army member's missing?

definitions.meaning: an affectionate old soldiers' name for Britain
what a homesick soldier posted abroad misses, his home country

explanation.surface: A soldier from a British territorial unit has gone absent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing' reads as absent but means pining for: the name was army slang from India.
explanation.definitionFit: The slang term for Britain, from a Hindustani word for foreign land, was used by troops abroad longing for home.

clue.text: Military leader left with lower ranks inside castle courtyard?

indicators.note: the left and ranks pieces sit within the courtyard word

parts.note: a ward is an open enclosed court within a castle's walls
OR stands for other ranks, soldiers below officer rank

explanation.surface: A general leaves his troops quartered within a castle's enclosure.
explanation.definitionFit: A regional strongman commanding his own private army is a military leader.

clue.text: Material girl getting man across the Channel?

definitions.meaning: a common French male first name

explanation.surface: A materialistic young woman finds herself a Frenchman.
explanation.walkthrough: Three senses: the cotton twill, a girl's name, and the French form of John.
explanation.definitionFit: The same word is a cloth, an English female name and a French masculine name.

clue.text: Crimes associated with those receiving swag?

parts.note: of means belonging to or connected with
fences are dealers in stolen goods

explanation.surface: Wrongdoings linked to receivers of loot.
explanation.definitionFit: Breaches of the law are illegal acts, a plain plural synonym.

clue.text: Legally get hold of little boy upset over school

indicators.note: in a down clue the reversed name sits above the school word
in a down clue, upset turns the name upside down, so it reads backwards

parts.note: Sid is a short boy's name, from Sidney
to school someone is to train them

explanation.surface: A small lad is upset about his school.
explanation.definitionFit: To seize goods in settlement of a debt is a legal procedure of taking possession.

clue.text: Poor people in shelters receiving old books

indicators.note: the shelters word takes in the books abbreviation

parts.note: havens are places of refuge
OT is the Old Testament, the older books of the Bible

explanation.surface: The needy in refuges are given second-hand books.
explanation.definitionFit: Those without wealth, contrasted with the haves, are the poor.

clue.text: Female impertinence making one lose the plot

parts.note: lip is cheeky backchat

explanation.surface: A woman's cheek drives somebody to distraction.
explanation.definitionFit: To go suddenly crazy or lose one's temper is an informal synonym for losing control.

clue.text: Woman's collecting information, making lists for meetings

indicators.note: the woman's name gathers the information piece into its middle

parts.note: Ada's: the girl's name Ada with its possessive S
gen is British slang for information

explanation.surface: A woman gathers facts to draw up running orders for committees.
explanation.definitionFit: Each is a schedule of items to be discussed at a meeting, plural to match.

clue.text: Knave joining gangster, a beast

parts.note: the knave in cards is the jack
Al Capone, the Chicago gangster

explanation.surface: A rogue teams up with a mobster, a brute.
explanation.definitionFit: The wild dog of Africa and Asia is an animal, the article matching.

clue.text: Famous German upset English in conflict

indicators.note: the reversed abbreviation goes within the conflict word

parts.note: war is armed conflict

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, read backwards

explanation.surface: A celebrated German disturbs the English during a war.
explanation.definitionFit: The composer of the Ring cycle is one of Germany's best-known figures.

clue.text: One who should be recipient of the last bit in Exeter, say

indicators.note: the last bit goes within the diocese word

parts.note: Exeter is a bishop's see, a diocese
the end is the final part

explanation.surface: Someone awaits delivery of the final scrap of something in a Devon city.
explanation.walkthrough: Exeter is a cathedral city in Devon; 'say' marks it as one example of a see.
explanation.definitionFit: The person to whom something is dispatched is the intended receiver.

clue.text: People coming in? Part of hospital goes mad

parts.note: ENT is the ear, nose and throat department
rants means raves angrily

explanation.surface: Arrivals at a ward are met by a department that loses its temper.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who enter a place or a competition are newcomers; the question mark flags the literal reading.

clue.text: Fellows, mature members of household

parts.note: fellows are men
to age is to mature

explanation.surface: Men grow older as grown-up members of a family.
explanation.definitionFit: The French-derived term for a domestic establishment means all those living together in one home.

clue.text: Salmon — what you expect on river

parts.note: par is the expected standard, as in golf

explanation.surface: A fish is just what an angler expects to catch on a river.
explanation.definitionFit: A young salmon before it heads to sea is given this name.

clue.text: Civil Service filled with utter weirdos

indicators.note: the service abbreviation is stuffed with the other word

parts.note: rank as an adjective means complete or utter, as in a rank outsider

explanation.surface: Government offices are packed with total oddballs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'utter' looks like a verb, to speak, but is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Eccentrics with obsessive odd ideas are called by this informal synonym for oddballs.

clue.text: See me on road, wandering around, abandoned

indicators.note: wandering around suggests the letters roam into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone asks to be watched roaming the highway, left behind.
explanation.definitionFit: Being left stranded on an island or isolated place is to be deserted.

clue.text: Individual transgression leads to joy being curtailed

parts.note: a sin is a transgression

indicators.note: curtailed means cut short at the tail, losing its final letter

parts.note: glee is joy

explanation.surface: A wrongdoing ends up spoiling one's happiness.
explanation.definitionFit: Something individual is one alone, separate from others.

clue.text: Keep quiet when given book

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet
to book a table is to reserve it

explanation.surface: A reader is told to stay silent once handed a novel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Keep quiet' reads as one phrase; 'Keep' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To save or maintain something unchanged is to keep it, a straightforward verb synonym.
